summary_en: ¥8,800M upper limit, 2,200,000 shares (4.65% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market purchase via ToSTNeT, Jul 29, 2026–Mar 24, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled on Mar 31, 2027 (4.09% of pre-cancellation issued capital).
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On July 28, 2026, the board of directors of Komeri Co., Ltd. resolved to acquire up to 2,200,000 treasury shares (4.65% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum expenditure of ¥8.8 billion. The shares will be purchased via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from July 29, 2026 through March 24, 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled on March 31, 2027, reducing issued capital by 4.09%. The company states the purpose is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 6,546,040 treasury shares against 47,263,128 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
